description: Desktop-only plugins: MPV player (no raw plugin command: launch, commands and video margins go through nyx_mpv_init / nyx_mpv_command / nyx_mpv_set_margins, process check via nyx_mpv_alive; mpv events are plain Tauri events), self-updater (download and install only: the check goes through nyx_update_check, without options from the page). No keyring: permission: the OS keyring is reached only through the guarded nyx_secret_* commands (src-tauri/src/secret_vault.rs)
